title: Insalubrious
summary: INSALU'BRIOUS, adjective [in and salubrious.] Not salubrious; not healthful; unfavorable to health; unwholesome; as an insalubrious air or climate.

inlines.v: INSALU'BRIOUS, adjective [in and salubrious.] Not salubrious; not healthful; unfavorable to health; unwholesome; as an insalubrious air or climate.
